result.topic_en: Notes belonging to the computation of secular perturbations: transforming the distance between a point in space and a point on an ellipse via a substitution with an auxiliary angle θ and the anomaly V.
result.transcription:
Litt: Z.
Zu der Berechnung der Secularstörungen gehörig
Der Abstand eines Punkts im Raume von einem Punkt der Ellipse hat die Form
$M\sqrt{\{(1-\alpha\cos(E+A))(1-\mathfrak{b}\cos(E+B))\}}$ wo $A+B=0$
Man setze
$\frac{1-\alpha\cos(E+A)}{1-\mathfrak{b}\cos(E+B)} = \frac{1-\alpha\mathfrak{b}\cos\Delta + \sqrt{(R-\alpha\alpha\mathfrak{b}\mathfrak{b}\sin\Delta^2)}.\cos\theta}{1-\mathfrak{b}\mathfrak{b}}$
wo $\Delta = A-B$, $R = \alpha\alpha+\mathfrak{b}\mathfrak{b}-2\alpha\mathfrak{b}\cos\Delta$.
So hat man
$\cos\theta = \frac{1}{(1-\mathfrak{b}\cos(E+B)).\sqrt{(R-\alpha\alpha\mathfrak{b}\mathfrak{b}\sin\Delta^2)}}\{\mathfrak{b}(\alpha\cos\Delta-\mathfrak{b}) - (\alpha\cos\Delta-\mathfrak{b})\cos(E+B) + \alpha(1-\mathfrak{b}\mathfrak{b})\sin\Delta\sin(E+B)\}$
$\sin\theta = \frac{\sqrt{(1-\mathfrak{b}\mathfrak{b})}}{1-\mathfrak{b}\cos(E+B).\sqrt{(R-\alpha\alpha\mathfrak{b}\mathfrak{b}\sin\Delta^2)}}\{\alpha\mathfrak{b}\sin\Delta - \alpha\sin\Delta\cos(E+B) - (\alpha\cos\Delta-\mathfrak{b})\sin(E+B)\}$
$(\alpha\cos\Delta-\mathfrak{b}).\cos\theta + \alpha\sqrt{(1-\mathfrak{b}\mathfrak{b})}.\sin\Delta.\sin\theta = \sqrt{(R-\alpha\alpha\mathfrak{b}\mathfrak{b}\sin\Delta^2)}.\frac{\mathfrak{b}-\cos(E+B)}{1-\mathfrak{b}\cos(E+B)}$
Man hätte die Verwandlung wohlfeilern Kaufs gehabt, wenn man sofort gesetzt hätte
$\tang\frac{1}{2}V = \sqrt{\frac{1+\mathfrak{b}}{1-\mathfrak{b}}}.\tang\frac{1}{2}(E+B) = T$
Es ist nemlich $\tg\frac{1}{2}(E+B) = t$ gesetzt
$\frac{1-\alpha\cos(E+A)}{1-\mathfrak{b}\cos(E+B)} = \frac{1+tt-\alpha\cos\Delta(1-tt)+2\alpha\sin\Delta\, t}{1+tt-\mathfrak{b}+\mathfrak{b}tt} = \frac{1+\frac{1-\mathfrak{b}}{1+\mathfrak{b}}TT - \alpha\cos\Delta(1-\frac{1-\mathfrak{b}}{1+\mathfrak{b}}TT) + 2\alpha\sin\Delta\sqrt{\frac{1-\mathfrak{b}}{1+\mathfrak{b}}}\,T}{1+\frac{1-\mathfrak{b}}{1+\mathfrak{b}}TT - \mathfrak{b} + \frac{\mathfrak{b}-\mathfrak{b}\mathfrak{b}}{1+\mathfrak{b}}TT}$
$= \frac{(1+\mathfrak{b})(1-\alpha\cos\Delta)\cos\frac{1}{2}V^2 + (1-\mathfrak{b})(1+\alpha\cos\Delta)\sin\frac{1}{2}V^2 + \alpha\sin\Delta\sqrt{(1-\mathfrak{b}\mathfrak{b})}\sin V}{1-\mathfrak{b}\mathfrak{b}}$
$\frac{dV}{\sin V} = \frac{\partial E}{\sin E}$
$= \frac{1-\alpha\mathfrak{b}\cos\Delta + (\mathfrak{b}-\alpha\cos\Delta)\cos V + \alpha\sin\Delta.\sqrt{(1-\mathfrak{b}\mathfrak{b})}.\sin V}{1-\mathfrak{b}\mathfrak{b}}$
$\frac{\partial E}{\partial V} = \frac{\sin(E+B)}{\sin V} = \frac{1-\mathfrak{b}\cos(E+B)}{\sqrt{(1-\mathfrak{b}\mathfrak{b})}}$

methods.what: Form of the distance between a point in space and a point on an ellipse
Substitution introducing auxiliary angle θ for the ratio of the two factors
Explicit expressions for cos θ and sin θ in terms of E
Linear relation between cos θ and sin θ
Resulting expression of the ratio linear in cos V, sin V
Derivative of E with respect to V
